entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal memory layer with multi-level support for user, session, and agent states. It features temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available through a managed cloud, self-hosted server, or an Apache-2.0 SDK.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight provides long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows for agents, supporting over 25 LLM providers including local models. It offers flexible deployment via Docker, Kubernetes, or managed cloud with client libraries for Python, Node.js, and Go.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an official Hermes context database that organizes information as a navigable filesystem using viking:// URIs and shell-like commands. It utilizes a three-tier loading system to achieve a 91% token reduction and significant task-completion gains over baselines.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee is a self-hosted knowledge graph engine that provides agents with persistent long-term memory across sessions. It builds searchable graphs from text, code, and conversations locally on a CPU without requiring external LLM API keys.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: As an official Hermes provider, Supermemory features a custom vector graph engine capable of sub-300ms recall at scales exceeding 100B tokens per month. It supports multi-modal extraction and byte-level deduplication to provide 100% prompt-cache discounts.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated agent brain stores facts with provenance and supports the correction or withdrawal of information. It exposes memory to agents via MCP on Tailscale tailnets and requires Bun 1.4.0 for installation.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a memory library for building stateful agents, serving as the upstream foundation for the honcho-self-hosted Hermes wrapper. It is implemented as a FastAPI server with SDKs for Python and TypeScript, supporting managed, local, and Docker deployments.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This official Hermes provider treats memory like a git repository, offering version control features such as commit, branch, and merge for markdown context trees. It utilizes a 5-tier retrieval system where four tiers are non-LLM based to ensure sub-100ms performance.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency memory system for Hermes Agents that runs on Python 3.10+ and a single SQLite database. It provides sub-millisecond performance and features episodic compression to manage storage growth at scale.
entries.moorcheh-ai/memanto: Memanto manages agent memory by reconciling conflicting information and superseding old knowledge with new facts. It supports cross-platform portability via the Open Knowledge Format and offers an on-prem mode with no outbound calls.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This system provides a seven-layer memory architecture for Hermes Agents, utilizing Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite for local infrastructure. It features a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context alongside structured facts and an auto-curated wiki.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive self-improving harness that generates playbooks and training artifacts from task runs to assist agents with complex tasks. It supports various LLM endpoints and provides entry points via CLI, MCP server, and Pi extensions.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin provides a lossless context engine for Hermes Agent using a SQLite store and a hierarchical DAG for message persistence. It ensures no messages are lost and includes specialized tools like lcm_grep and lcm_recall for precise detail recovery.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes local session history from 35 supported coding agents to provide automated recall during session starts or command failures. It allows users to search months of past sessions and synchronizes history between machines via SSH without relying on cloud storage.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: Honcho enables private, cross-session memory for Hermes Agent through a self-hosted backend supported by Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis. It is compatible with any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider or local inference servers.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI offers a local-first identity and memory layer that maintains portable state across Hermes Agent and other MCP clients. It supports real-time data ingestion from Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub, achieving high answer accuracy on LongMemEval benchmarks.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer uses a human-readable YAML engram format to store context on local disks for multi-agent systems. It utilizes local-first retrieval methods, including BGE-small and optional rerankers, to maintain context across various coding agents.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates entirely locally without cloud dependencies or API key requirements. It employs a hybrid retrieval system combining BM25, vector search, and multi-graph traversal, integrating via MCP servers and agent plugins.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This file-based long-term memory system uses a SQLite-backed five-tier hierarchical schema with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It is delivered as a five-package plugin family that includes a dedicated Hermes adapter and support for major operating systems.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes long-context inference by reordering text and multimodal context to facilitate prefix-cache sharing. It integrates with Hermes Agent and various inference engines to provide deduplication and cache-aware scheduling.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This embedded plugin provides explainable retrieval by tagging every recalled item with a reason for its selection. It features built-in contradiction tracking and recency ranking to help agents resolve conflicts within their memory.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn uses an Obsidian vault as a source of truth, storing durable memory as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter metadata. It employs a local DuckDB cache for hybrid search, ensuring memory remains daemonless and user-owned.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: This proactive memory CLI allows agents to autonomously maintain and evolve persistent knowledge stored in local SQLite and Wiki files. It supports team synchronization through a self-hosted server with granular permission controls.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: Flowstate-qmd implements anticipatory memory by watching agent session logs to prefetch context into a local-first cache. Built with SQLite-vec and node-llama-cpp, this MCP-native server provides automated configuration for major coding agent clients.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: A memory kernel stack that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide the agent with purpose-built evidence packets per query.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: A reflective memory system featuring semantic search with BM25 full-text and ranked graph traversal. It provides automated indexing for URLs, codebases, and multimedia with OCR support, using edge tags for bidirectional relationships.
entries.aliasocracy/hermes-tool-slimmer: A middleware integration for Hermes version 0.19+ that reduces tool schema token overhead via local keyword-based ranking. It includes a dashboard for managing tool configurations and monitoring token savings.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-context-os: A Git-backed context and workflow layer providing adapters for Codex, Claude Code, and other compatible coding agents. It utilizes Markdown for durable decision logs and context, requiring manual review for updates.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: A local-only plugin using a single .lbdb embedded graph database file. It employs BM25 keyword search and importance-weighted recall to surface high-priority memories during context prefetch.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: A pull-model episodic memory plugin that supports immediate event deletion and an on-demand summarizer. It maintains a trace.jsonl audit log of all prefetch operations.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: A plugin for indexing and routing local capabilities, including MCP server configurations, scripts, and runbooks. It provides five native tools for retrieval and uses session hooks to deliver system-prompt hints.
entries.piprail/piprail: An MCP server and TypeScript SDK that enables budget-bound agent wallets via x402 payments. It supports USDC and stablecoins across Solana, EVM, and eight other chain families without requiring a backend or database.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: A durable cross-session memory provider that uses a local SQLite layer for caching and write reliability. It features native lifecycle hooks for snapshots and pre-turn recall, allowing agents to read memories from other connected agents.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: A plugin integrating Exabase M-1 for self-organizing long-term memory. It provides tools for manual storage and searching, with support for result reranking and configurable query expansion.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: A private local code memory plugin that requires a SourceVault server for vector storage and indexing. It adds deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools for file reads, sync, and semantic search.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: An AI-native memory solution featuring AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval. It can be executed via an HTTP daemon or native Rust FFI.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 specialized tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal, utilizing a hybrid search approach that integrates BM25, vector, and graph methods. It further supports agent efficiency by implementing automatic context checkpointing during message compression to preserve relevant information.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: Designed as a file-based hygiene layer, this kit uses 'rot' and 'lint' curators to identify stale or conflicting facts within plain markdown files. It manages memory updates through evidence-cited JSON diffs and leverages a local git repository to track and revert changes without requiring a database.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a software development methodology centered on TDD, YAGNI, and DRY principles. It automates the transition from spec elicitation to implementation planning while supporting various coding harnesses and CLI tools.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system for design and prototyping that offers native runtime support for the DeepSeek Harness agent. It enables the generation of motion graphics, slides, and web prototypes through integrations with Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, and NIST CSF 2.0. The collection is compatible with over 26 AI platforms for comprehensive security operations.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill converts codebases, schemas, and infrastructure-as-code into draw.io diagrams using natural language descriptions. It features a CLI and MCP server that support incremental synchronization while preserving manual layout changes.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this project provides a master router for delegated permissions and x402 payments. It incorporates vendored protocol skills to facilitate escrow and dispute resolution within a unified verification layer.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using professional, technical, or casual voice profiles. It supports detect-only and edit-in-place modes for agents compatible with agentskills.io.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project uses an agentic evolver to automate skill deduplication and quality improvement across teams and devices. It unifies skill libraries for Hermes, Claude Code, and OpenAI-compatible APIs through background evolution.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with agent-plugins.org specifications. It maintains session state locally within a project's documentation folder to support Claude Code and Codex agents.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,176 markdown-based skills covering 35 professions that run natively in Hermes Agent without requiring telemetry or user accounts. It provides ready-to-paste exports for use across Claude, Gemini, and Cursor.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill enables video search, transcript extraction, and playlist browsing for agents including Windsurf and OpenClaw. It requires a TranscriptAPI key to process YouTube data directly within the agent workflow.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically propose and generate reusable skills. It produces both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, which users can manage via dedicated slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project teaches agents to generate their own analytical prompts and custom thinking instructions for specific tasks. It utilizes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for agentskills.io with progressive disclosure for Pydantic AI. It enables remote skill registries via Git and S3 while offering sandboxed execution to isolate untrusted scripts from the host.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill implements literate programming by weaving prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It features a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the original literate documentation.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents through Lite and Full complexity modes. It ensures quality control via a spec review gate that utilizes PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro serves as a harness for long-running agents, utilizing a mechanism kernel for SQLite storage and event logging. It coordinates agent teams via the SLP protocol and distributes prompt-first methods as Markdown recipes.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory using markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning to replacement models based on recorded work.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource provides a registry of Portuguese-language skills, guides for VPS deployment, and MCP integration. It supports streamlined skill installation through a CLI tap or direct raw URLs.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Following the Agent Skills specification, this project enables interactions with oracle networks and smart contracts. It supports CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds, with installation managed via the Vercel CLI.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills integrate the BFL API for FLUX image and video generation, including support for polling and webhooks. The suite features eight specialist skills specifically designed for FLUX 3 video prompting.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories, documentation, and SaaS APIs into verified agentskills.io-compliant skills. It generates instruction files with AST-based citations and maintains an audit trail through provenance maps and evidence reports.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika is a local-first workflow language that converts plain-text job descriptions into .nika files using a Rust binary. It audits tool permissions and costs before execution and uses hash-chained records to verify run integrity.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry offers reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification, accessible via a Python client or CLI. It manages recursive dependency resolution during installation and incorporates commerce features using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Designed for complex multi-step tasks, this skill enables autonomous execution with real-time progress tracking. It includes built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures to ensure safe recovery during long-running operations.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: HermesHub serves as a community hub for browsing and installing skills, utilizing the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates 24/7 on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search integration across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: Eagle Eye implements a five-layer retrieval system using hard triggers and semantic embeddings to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. This approach reduces token usage and features graceful degradation if specific embedding models or dependencies are unavailable.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token consumption during tool discovery. It employs a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incrementally discovers server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Life_OS is a personal execution system that uses MCP connections for agent-driven scheduling of habits and study blocks. It stores data locally in a single SQLite file and offers interfaces via a React web app and an Expo-based Android application.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across multiple surfaces like Discord and Telegram, achieving a 20–80% reduction in token usage. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: HermaGuard performs adversarial code reviews by deploying three parallel subagents to identify edge cases and integration issues. It combines deterministic pre-scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings through proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses a swarm of three sub-agents to improve code hygiene, clarity, and correctness across five programming languages. The simplification process includes a tiered application system protected by an approval gate.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates for systematic debugging. It includes a Python goal engine for persistent state management and an investigation protocol designed to prevent early-stop errors.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey lab equips Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and OWASP, to address CVE-driven scenarios.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern supports progressive disclosure through SKILL.md files. It integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based loading and automatically registers common agent skill directories.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This repository provides markdown-based workflow procedures for session management, worktree recovery, and PR reviews. These production-tested skills are compatible with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability for Hermes Agent, tracking token costs, session history, and skill analytics. It ensures data privacy through read-only access and local log desensitization while offering optional incident alerting via Telegram and Feishu.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill enables agents to generate reproducible demo GIFs for repositories using vhs or Playwright recording scripts. It optimizes output files to stay under 8 MB and supports a variety of interfaces including CLIs, TUIs, and web applications.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This tool allows agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills directly from the terminal. It provides direct installation commands and integrates with MCP-compatible clients such as Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: Designed to prevent technical debt, this skill generates Claude Code extensions and portable agent skills that adhere to current frontmatter specifications. It includes a validator with CI-friendly exit codes and monitors official spec changes weekly to detect field drift.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This project implements a self-improvement loop that analyzes session history to propose skill coverage gaps. It uses a local Python framework to gate updates behind deterministic and LLM-judge evaluators without requiring external services.
entries.superagnt/leverage: Leverage provides agents with skills for social data, CRM management, and lead enrichment alongside a workspace Postgres instance. It includes an MCP server for browser-based OAuth authentication and supports agentskills.io compliant clients.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection offers specialized utilities for video transcription, document OCR via macOS Vision, and e-commerce material processing. It features a rule-based engine designed to remove common Chinese AI writing patterns from generated text.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This runtime utility manages deterministic path routing and Python interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. It ensures file operations use environment-specific syntax and verifies project-compatible interpreters without requiring new installations.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC across multiple protocols including Pay Link and x402. It is built to be compatible with the agentskills.io standard and the Hermes Agent ecosystem.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: Skillseal provides a quality assurance framework that tests agent skills for structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable Ed25519 certificates to confirm that a skill operates as intended.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin enables agents to participate in a decentralized support economy by earning USDC on the Base network via the x402 protocol. Users can list bounties, submit drafts, and manage funded boards without requiring accounts or API keys.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This project provides structured web data access across 31 platforms through an MCP server exposing 191 tools. It includes five production-grade workflow skills compatible with Hermes, Claude, Cursor, and OpenHands.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill enables Hermes Agent to generate multi-scale Chinese news reports ranging from global events to street-level updates. It utilizes semantic memory to align search results with user interests, producing structured briefings that include core conclusions and actionable suggestions.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes, across terminal, desktop, and IDE environments. It is included for users seeking a package-managed approach to development tools on Nix-supported systems.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running the Antigravity CLI and OpenClaw on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables mobile deployment by leveraging Termux:API and Termux:GUI for hardware and interface access.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a Termux-based automated installation script that utilizes proot-distro Ubuntu to run Hermes Agent on Android. It supports interactive model setup, shell command execution, and connectivity with both local Ollama models and external providers.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates Kubernetes deployments by enforcing single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows with configurable gateway, API, and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: Providing a one-command installer for both Android (Termux) and iOS (iSH), this project brings the Hermes AI assistant to mobile platforms. It distinguishes itself by integrating Telegram for voice and file messaging alongside support for scheduled cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides a sandboxed environment for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell for hardware-enforced security. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access while allowing for configurable security policies regarding web searches and messaging.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for deploying and operating Hermes agents on Docker and Kubernetes via Helm charts. It features a 69-entry credential catalog, support for over 17 LLM providers, and mandatory AES-256-GCM encryption for all secrets.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image that combines the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted directories and allows users to target specific Hermes versions using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and settings. It offers a hybrid management system for skills and integrates with sops-nix for secure secrets handling via systemd.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane designed to orchestrate multiple agent instances with distinct identities and workspaces from a single web application. It manages granular permissions for tools and networks while providing dedicated Telegram and WhatsApp communication channels.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Targeting headless Ubuntu and Debian environments, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is designed for production-ready autonomous execution of recurring AI tasks via cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in offline or isolated environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework deploys specialized agents to perform fundamental, sentiment, and technical financial analysis. It features a research team that debates bullish and bearish perspectives and supports backtesting with SEC EDGAR integration and point-in-time data integrity.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform governs agent registration, task dispatching, memory browsing, and cost tracking. Users can manage multi-agent workflows through a Web UI, CLI, or MCP server, with support for local Node.js or Docker deployments.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent, using tmux for persistent background execution. It provides TUI and web-based dashboards with diff review capabilities and supports sandboxing via Docker, Podman, and Apple Containers.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Designed for scaling Hermes Agent from single instances to automated teams, this template utilizes a level-based architecture and a task bus pattern for delegation. It includes bundled skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework enables the construction of autonomous agent swarms across 23+ LLM providers, including OpenAI and Ollama. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts to manage agent team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This platform provides a centralized screen for supervising autonomous Hermes Agent work through a Kanban board and live streaming of agent reasoning. It requires human-in-the-loop verification for all agent-proposed task completions to ensure oversight.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure roles. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for precise routing and coordination.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using Hermes Agent profiles and the MCP and ACP protocols. It features a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and managing task lifecycles via a Kanban flow.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code for Hermes Agent. It orchestrates evaluations for TBLite and TerminalBench-2 while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies to vie for GitHub stars. Using Paperclip and Hermes Agent for execution, the system visualizes agent tasks and scoreboard metrics on a real-time dashboard.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080/5080. It uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling, utilizing parallel model querying and synthesis without cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that reduces token usage and tool calls for Hermes Agent. It features a built-in MCP server and auto-syncs the index on every file change to maintain up-to-date context.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI tool that tracks token usage across multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes, through a terminal UI and 3D visualization dashboard. It allows users to monitor their consumption and submit data to public leaderboards and profiles.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables developers to inspect API traffic from Hermes Agent and other coding tools while redacting authentication headers for security. It exports trace sessions into self-contained HTML files for detailed analysis of agent interactions.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time tracking of tokens, costs, and rate limits by reading Hermes Agent state directly. It supports multi-device synchronization and offers detailed usage breakdowns by model, session, and project.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance to Hermes Agent via MCP servers to improve UI construction. It is compatible with any AI provider supporting markdown and integrates directly into the agent's workflow.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer adds 36 skills and 6 specialized workflows to Hermes Agent, coordinating seven agent roles through a CTO loop. It automates the entire lifecycle of an application, from building and deployment to health checks and log observation.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins allows users to customize the Hermes terminal UI with YAML-based themes, including retro DOS and cyberpunk aesthetics. The tool modifies visual elements such as banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control, featuring a supervisor sidebar for managing Hermes Agent approvals and checkpoints. It supports external MCP clients and browser automation workflows across various AI providers.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol and human-readable @handles. It enables Hermes Agent to participate in commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This project ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to run natively within the Claude Code Channel without external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: Lintlang is a static linter that evaluates AI agent configurations and system prompts using HERM v1.1 scoring. It identifies ambiguous tool overlaps and missing progress conditions, generating SARIF or JSON reports for CI integration.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory integrations for various frameworks using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It supports chat platforms like Slack and Telegram, extending the persistent memory capabilities available to agents.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during agent operations. It includes over 40 pre-configured skills for finance, devops, and research, supported by automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md is a TAW Agent framework that enables per-folder scoping for Hermes Agents, allowing for project-local memories and custom instructions. It facilitates seamless switching between default and scoped agents based on the local configuration and skills defined within a directory.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of the hermes-agent stack and 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It provides immediate access to 29 community plugins and supports free models to ensure a zero-cost production environment.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions users from OpenClaw to Hermes Agent by mapping SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and skills into compatible YAML and JSON formats. It also configures systemd gateway services and handles the conversion of nested authentication structures.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco provides self-healing observability for multi-agent systems through a native Hermes plugin that exports real-time telemetry without cloud dependencies. It uses config-aware baselines to detect performance drift and offers both passive zero-token analysis and active probing.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Designed for local runtime by default, this project focuses on secure task execution by requiring explicit approval for all external writes and consequential actions. It includes specific contracts for managing opportunities and offer-previews to help users generate income using Hermes Agent.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled assistant adds offline, wake-word capabilities to Hermes Agent without requiring API keys or accounts. It supports 35 languages and features adaptive turn-taking, allowing users to interact with their agent through a fully local voice interface.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin for Hermes supports multi-dimensional storage and semantic search for managing agent information. It includes a built-in circuit breaker to handle MemOS API outages while providing tools to search, add, and delete memories.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager for Windows, macOS, and Linux enables one-click switching between different API providers for Hermes Agent and other CLIs. It functions as an all-in-one tool for managing configurations across multiple agent platforms including Claude Code and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application that supports autonomous multi-step tasks with user approval and file access for Hermes Agent. It features built-in assistants for generating editable office files and enables 24/7 unattended automation through cron and remote access interfaces.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: This web and mobile interface provides 1:1 parity with the Hermes CLI experience using a three-panel layout for sessions, chat, and file browsing. It is built with Python and vanilla JavaScript, intentionally avoiding frameworks or bundlers.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app simplifies the setup process through guided installation with dependency resolution for Hermes Agent. It provides a GUI for chat, session management, and tool configuration while supporting multiple AI providers and local endpoints.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio: This web dashboard features a unified configuration for 10 platforms including Telegram, Discord, and Slack, alongside usage analytics for token and cost tracking. It supports visual workflows that incorporate scheduled jobs and human approval gates.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace includes a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and a dedicated skills manager with an MCP catalog. It features a Swarm Mode that utilizes role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for agent coordination.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative coding workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and other ACP-compatible agents into a single desktop or self-hosted environment. It includes fifteen built-in agents and offers native mobile clients for both iOS and Android.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts with an embedded terminal for shell access. It features native views for managing sessions, Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop application includes a built-in kernel for health checks and updates. The interface supports LaTeX and Markdown rendering for chat, memory management, and process monitoring.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects active browser contexts to local, cloud, or remote Hermes Agent runtimes. It provides site-aware drafting assistance across 31 writing environments and tools for tab triage and page commenting.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app for iOS 18+ that allows users to drive a self-hosted Hermes agent from their phone by pairing with a web server. It enables real-time chat streaming and remote management of agent tasks, skills, and workspace files.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines while providing custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking token usage and latency alongside a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI consciousness monitor features nine tabs, four color themes, and a tmux operator view for managing live agent panes. It tracks agent growth, git projects, and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: A self-hosted web dashboard providing a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and real-time chat with tool call visualization. It includes an MCP server control plane and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser and agent cockpit that searches local prompts, tool calls, and errors across 16 agent formats. It tracks per-session quota burn and API-equivalent costs for Codex and Claude using local search indexes.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace connects to Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts with one-click automated Hermes Agent installation. It features an integrated WebRTC voice mode using OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: A self-hostable dashboard template that uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It includes an approval inbox for requests involving side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: An alternative TUI and dashboard built with OpenTUI for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It features a kanban board for task management and supports managing profiles, skills, cron jobs, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA designed for the Telegram Mini App v2.0 that supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances. The interface provides terminal chat with streaming responses, file attachments, and dual authentication methods.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: A portable Windows desktop environment that runs via contained Python and Node.js environments without requiring installation or admin rights. It includes 100 tools for TTS, music, and ComfyUI, alongside a built-in workflow engine.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface for self-hosted chat and real-time log streaming. The dashboard integrates a file browser, task tracking, and management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This dashboard provides real-time monitoring of session activity and cost tracking. Users can perform full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, alongside read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted workspace featuring a chat-first interface with real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profile management for separate memory and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: A multi-agent desktop client that orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It offers a visual Skill Store with over 50 curated installations and a native interface for streaming SSE responses.
